title: Time Spiral Timeshifted: card flavor text

entities.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
entities.description: An angel whose motto is no rest, no mercy.

entities.name: Auratog
entities.description: A creature that enjoys eating its wards.

entities.name: Slivers
entities.description: Creatures that would survive even at the expense of every other creature on Otaria; also subject of a Mogg children's rhyme.

entities.name: Otaria
entities.description: A land where slivers would survive at the expense of all other creatures.

entities.name: Moorish Cavalry
entities.description: An elite cavalry whose members choose only mounts of pure bloodline.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: A people who sing the "Song to the Sun" warning of Sacred Mesa.

entities.name: Soltari
entities.description: A people whose priest says there is greater need for prayer in Rath; Lyna is their emissary.

entities.name: Rath
entities.description: A place where a Soltari priest says there is even greater need for prayer.

entities.name: Scroll of Beginnings
entities.description: An in-world writing that tells of Valor spreading through the land.

entities.name: Valor
entities.description: A being who spread throughout the land after a shell crumbled.

entities.name: Sidar Jabari
entities.description: A commander quoted on the nature of command.

entities.name: Faysal al-Mousa
entities.description: A fisher captain whose log is quoted.

entities.name: Saffiyah
entities.description: A person who clapped her hands and summoned twenty flying men.

entities.name: Flying Men
entities.description: Twenty well-trained combatants who appeared at Saffiyah's side.

entities.name: Mireille Gaetane
entities.description: Author of The Valeriad, which describes a phantom prow splitting a storm.

entities.name: Lord of Atlantis
entities.description: A master of tactics who makes his people bold in battle merely by arriving.

entities.name: Institute of Arcane Study
entities.description: An institution whose members sometimes acquire a taste for worldly pleasures.

entities.name: Stormscape
entities.description: A school whose apprentices must raise and train an owl before attaining master rank.

entities.name: Crovax
entities.description: A speaker who followed a song only to find it was a dirge.

entities.name: Lyna
entities.description: A Soltari emissary who speaks of the Dauthi.

entities.name: Dauthi
entities.description: A people said to have knives for every soul.

entities.name: Eron the Relentless
entities.description: A figure in Sengir's service, called a hassle by Reyhan.

entities.name: Reyhan
entities.description: A Samite alchemist.

entities.name: Shadow Guild
entities.description: A guild with the maxim about keeping the dead so others may live.

entities.name: Suq'Ata
entities.description: A people with a saying that there are medicines for all afflictions but idleness.

entities.name: Uncle Istvan
entities.description: A hermit driven insane by solitude who keeps company with those he can catch.

entities.name: Jeska
entities.description: A warrior adept.

entities.name: Ib Halfheart
entities.description: A goblin tactician.

entities.name: Eladamri
entities.description: Lord of Leaves.

entities.name: Telim'Tor
entities.description: A speaker urging never to stop until a lance comes out the other side.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer.

entities.name: Qhattib
entities.description: The vizier of Amiqat.

entities.name: Harthag
entities.description: A giant who laughs at the army before him.

entities.name: Arna Kennerud
entities.description: A skycaptain.

entities.name: Jolrael, Empress of Beasts
entities.description: A ruler who says she needs no army because she has Jamuraa.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A land Jolrael claims as her army.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: An artificer who says a perfect machine can be built from imperfect parts and who advised Teferi on isolation.

entities.name: Teferi
entities.description: A person to whom Urza says isolation is not the answer.

entities.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
entities.description: A Balduvian chieftain.

entities.name: Jasmine Boreal
entities.description: A speaker who says peace must prevail even if the wicked must die.

entities.name: Vhati il-Dal
entities.description: A subordinate rebuked by Greven for thinking.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: A commander who tells Vhati not to think.

entities.name: Brotherhood of Gix
entities.description: A group that dug out the cave of Koilos and found their master's severed hand.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: The master of the Brotherhood of Gix, whose severed hand was found in Koilos.

entities.name: Koilos
entities.description: A cave dug out by the Brotherhood of Gix.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The destination the Brotherhood of Gix hoped Gix's hand would point to.

entities.name: Feldon
entities.description: A person who found the first of the canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.

entities.name: Ronom Glacier
entities.description: A glacier in which Feldon found a cane.

entities.name: Braids
entities.description: A dementia summoner.

entities.name: Mirari
entities.description: A powerful object said to offer what you want, not what you need.

entities.name: Mishra
entities.description: An artificer whose earlier days saw the invention of the rack.

entities.name: The Rack
entities.description: Once Mishra's most feared creation.

entities.name: Tormod's Crypt
entities.description: A crypt whose dark opening seems to breathe cold, damp air.

entities.name: Pendelhaven
entities.description: A forest described in Longfellow's verse.

events.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix finds their master's severed hand in the cave of Koilos and enshrines it.
events.quote: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand.

events.summary: Feldon finds the first of the canes frozen in the Ronom Glacier.
